changelog: Server-side detection of what cheat menus do to other players, even stream-proof ones: weapons given or removed, players ejected or frozen, particle and projectile spam.
Injected resource detection (Lua executors), super jump detection and aimbot statistics alerts (headshot ratio, abnormal kill distance).
Fixed honeypots that could ban honest players on ESX / QBCore (real framework events were used as traps).
